title: To Thee, O Dear, Dear Savior
description: To Thee, O Dear, Dear Savior in Tonic Solfa to ANGEL'S STORY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Samuel Bewley Monsell wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 371.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ANGEL'S STORY; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: To Thee, O dear, dear Sa-vior, My spir-it turns for rest, My peace is in Thy fa-vor, My pil-low on Thy breast; Though all the world de-ceive me, I know that I am Thine, And Thou wilt nev-er leave me, O blessed Sa-vi-or mine.

lines: To Thee, O dear, dear Savior,
My peace is in Thy favor,
Though all the world deceive me,
I know that I am Thine,
And Thou wilt never leave me,
O Thou whose mercy found me,
My grief is in the dulness
My joy is in Thy beauty
That binds my life in Thine.
Have failed in love to Thee,
Oh, for a heart to love Thee
In deed or word or thought!
Oh, for the bliss that by it

licence: Public domain: John Samuel Bewley Monsell died in 1875.
credits: Words by John Samuel Bewley Monsell (1811–1875), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ANGEL'S STORY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
